title: 第9章  血妖卷宗
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
司务堂坐落在青州镇魔司的东南角，是一栋三进深的青砖瓦房。
发俸禄、领差事、兑换功绩、餐食住宿等事宜全都在这里办理。
大门口，进出来往的镇魔卫络绎不绝。
周通也在其中了。
他要让陆渊受到严惩，就要先查到陆渊的住处。
只不过，现在好像不需要去查了。
“陆渊！”
周通喊了一声，叫住了正要前往司务堂接取任务的陆渊。
后者转头，眼中露出几分疑惑。
就见周通负手而立，面色不善地看着他。
“我是周通，云安县的选拔考官，跟我来，有事找你。”
陆渊收回目光，转身迈步，“没空。”
周通神情一滞，紧接着脸色涨得通红。
他入门七年，虽说不算什么大人物，但在刚入门的新人面前，他可是当之无愧的前辈、上官。
在他看来，陆渊在听到他的呼喊之后，应该是乖乖过来听后发落。
却没想到对方只是轻飘飘撂下两个字，转身直接走了。
就那么走了！
他可是在册七年的镇魔卫啊！
竟然被一个刚入门的新人无视了！
周通的脸色难看至极，从没见过如此狂妄的新人，竟敢当众不给他面子！

简直是岂有此理！
胸中怒火上涌，周通阴沉着脸，快步上前。
“陆渊，我是青州镇魔司在册七年的镇魔卫，找你有事。”
“有事说事。”陆渊脚下不停。
周通心中怒意更甚，对方这态度，明显没将他当一回事。
他强压下心头的火气，沉声问道：“昨天入门考核，是你动手将林辰打成重伤？”
陆渊侧目看去，“是又如何？”
“你不顾同门之谊出手伤人，导致林辰重伤昏迷，我要你负荆请罪。”
“嗯。”
闻言，周通脸上的怒意淡去几分，神色中多出几分高傲。
“这还差不多......”
还得是我！
只是亮出在册七年的镇魔卫身份，这小子就主动服软了。
狂妄新人？
还不是随手拿捏！
周通冷哼一声，接着说道：“行了，你现在就跟我去医房，先给家属赔礼道歉，等林辰醒了再由他来决定怎么处置你。”
“嗯。”
陆渊应了一声，脚下始终没停过。
周通眉头一皱，意识到不对劲了。
“不是说去医房吗？”

“嗯。”
“那你还不去？”
“去。”
“那你倒是去啊！”
“不急。”
“什么意思？”
“我去买几个橘子，你就在此地，不要走动。”
“......”
周通脸色阴沉下来，这才反应过来自己被耍了。
司务堂哪有卖橘子的？
他双眼一瞪，一脸恼怒，“好好好，狂妄的新人我见多了，像你这么狂的还是头一个！”
“竟敢耍我！行，今天我要你知道什么叫做规矩......”
“周大人。”
陆渊开口打断，语气戏谑道：“你的规矩我不知道，但这司务堂的规矩，你得知道。”
陆渊一指大门旁边立着的木牌，周通脸色微变，顿觉一腔怒火无处发泄。
木牌之上，一列红色大字非常醒目：
司务堂重地严禁争斗，违者重罚。
“哼！”
周通恶狠狠地一甩袖子，咬牙切齿。
“陆渊，你给我等着！”

......
司务堂内。
穿过走廊，陆渊来到了差事房门口。
刚一跨进门槛，就看到一个熟悉身影。
正好，对方也看到了他。
“哎哟，陆大人，这不巧了嘛，又遇到您了。”
苏定安堆着笑容凑了上来，恭敬之中带着几分生意人的市侩。
“哦？你也来领差事？”陆渊眼中也露出意外之色。
“那倒不是......”苏定安一脸神秘，压低声音道：“陆大人，实话跟您说吧，别看司务堂规矩森严，咱也不是没有人。”
说着，他朝柜台方向努了努嘴。
“那个，书吏老刘，他媳妇的三姨娘的侄女的婆家，跟我老家是一个村的，论起来，我得管他叫一声表姨夫的连襟。”
陆渊嘴角微微一抽，这关系绕的，换个不识字的都得当场迷路。
苏定安倒不觉得什么，顺嘴问道：“陆大人是来领差事？”
陆渊点头，“不错。”
“那正好！这差事房的门道我熟啊！”
“哪个差事油水多，哪个差事风险低，哪个容易立功，只要陆大人开口，我一定给您找到。”
“只不过嘛......找一个差事五钱银子。”
苏定安嘿嘿一笑，眼睛里闪着精光。
陆渊思索片刻，从怀中摸出五钱碎银，递了过去。
“陆大人大气！”

苏定安比了个大拇指，接过银子顺势塞入袖中，动作行云流水。
再抬头，他神情之中已经多了几分正色。
“不知陆大人想接哪种差事？”
“能斩杀妖魔的。”陆渊脱口而出，接着又补充道：“妖魔数量要多，最好都是同一种。”
“同一种？”苏定安眼睛一眨，“为什么？”
“练手。”
陆渊随口敷衍，毕竟词条的事不便外传。
苏定安听了，若有所思地点了点头，双眼顿时一亮。
“有道理！有道理！”
“杀同一种妖，杀得越多理解越深刻，一旦顺手了就是砍瓜切菜！”
“哎哟，我之前怎么没想到这一层？”
“......”
苏定安一边念叨着，一边转身向着墙边的柜子走去。
很快，他拿着一份卷宗走了过来。
“陆大人，前几日赤霞县上报了一桩妖患，正好符合您的要求。”
“什么妖魔？”陆渊眼底闪过一抹兴奋。
“血妖！”
苏定安脸上笑意收敛，难得露出几分认真。
“血妖这东西邪性的很，被它杀死的人会被转化为新的血妖，新的血妖再杀人，又能变成血妖。”
“所以，只要有一只血妖杀人，用不了几天，一窝子就出来了。”

“既然都是一个妈生的，肯定都是同一种妖。”
陆渊点头，翻开卷宗，看了一眼有关赤霞县妖患的情报：
近日来，赤霞县境内数十名初境武者接连失踪，生不见人死不见尸。
有人目睹，陈家府邸在深夜爆发血光，虽只短短一瞬，但妖气惊人，疑似有血妖潜伏。
陆明点头，收起卷宗。
“行，就这个了。”
content_en:
The Siwu Hall is located in the southeast corner of the Mosi in Qingzhou Town. It is a three-by-three-deep blue brick building.
All matters such as salary payment, receiving errands, exchange of merit, meals and accommodation are handled here.
At the gate, there was an endless stream of demon-suppressing guards coming in and out.
Zhou Tong was among them.
If he wants Lu Yuan to be severely punished, he must first find out where Lu Yuan lives.
However, it seems that there is no need to check now.
"Lu Yuan!"
Zhou Tong shouted and stopped Lu Yuan who was about to go to the Siwu Hall to pick up the task.
The latter turned his head, with some doubts in his eyes.
He saw Zhou Tong standing with his hands behind his back, looking at him with an unkind expression.
"I'm Zhou Tong, the selection examiner of Yun'an County. Follow me. If I need anything, I'll see you."
Lu Yuan withdrew his gaze, turned around and stepped forward, "No time."
Zhou Tong's expression froze, and then his face turned red.
He has been in the industry for seven years. Although he is not a big shot, he is a well-deserved senior and superior officer in front of the newcomers.
In his opinion, after hearing his cry, Lu Yuan should have come over obediently and listened and then regretted it.
But he didn't expect that the other party just said two words lightly, turned around and left directly.
Just leave!
He is the demon-suppressing guard who has been registered for seven years!
He was actually ignored by a newbie!
Zhou Tong's face was extremely ugly. He had never seen such an arrogant newcomer before, how dare he not give him face in public!
This is simply unreasonable!
Anger welled up in his chest, Zhou Tong stepped forward quickly with a gloomy face.
"Lu Yuan, I am the Demon Suppressing Guard who has been registered with the Qingzhou Demon Suppressing Division for seven years. I have something to do with you."
"You have something to say." Lu Yuan kept walking.
Zhou Tong was even more angry. The other party's attitude clearly didn't take him seriously.
He suppressed the anger in his heart and asked in a deep voice: "Did you beat Lin Chen seriously during the entrance examination yesterday?"
Lu Yuan looked sideways, "So what?"
"You disregarded the friendship of your fellow students and hurt someone, causing Lin Chen to be seriously injured and comatose. I want you to bear the burden and apologize."
"Yeah."
Hearing this, the anger on Zhou Tong's face faded a bit, and his expression became a bit more arrogant.
"That's pretty much it..."
It has to be me!
Just by showing his identity as a demon-suppressing guard who had been registered for seven years, this kid voluntarily surrendered.
Arrogant newcomer?
It’s not just something you can do at your fingertips!
Zhou Tong snorted coldly and then said: "Okay, you can go to the hospital with me now and apologize to your family first. When Lin Chen wakes up, he will decide what to do with you."
"Yeah."
Lu Yuan responded, never stopping.
Zhou Tong frowned and realized something was wrong.
"Didn't you say go to the hospital?"
"Yeah."
"Then you still won't go?"
"Go."
"Then you should go!"
"No rush."
"What do you mean?"
"I'm going to buy some oranges. You stay here and don't move around."
"..."
Zhou Tong's face darkened, and then he realized that he had been tricked.
Is there anyone selling oranges in Si Wu Tang?
His eyes widened with an angry look on his face, "Okay, okay, I've seen a lot of arrogant newcomers, but this is the first one as arrogant as you!"
"How dare you trick me! Okay, today I want you to know what the rules are..."
"Master Zhou."
Lu Yuan interrupted and said in a joking tone: "I don't know your rules, but you have to know the rules of the Siwu Hall."
Lu Yuan pointed at the wooden sign standing next to the door. Zhou Tong's face changed slightly, and he suddenly felt that he had nowhere to vent his anger.
On the wooden sign, a row of red characters is very eye-catching:
Fighting is strictly prohibited in the important areas of the Siwu Hall, and violators will be severely punished.
"Hmph!"
Zhou Tong shook his sleeves fiercely and gritted his teeth.
"Lu Yuan, just wait for me!"
...
In the Siwu Hall.
After walking through the corridor, Lu Yuan came to the door of the errand room.
As soon as I stepped across the threshold, I saw a familiar figure.
Fortunately, the other party also saw him.
"Oh, Mr. Lu, what a coincidence, I meet you again."
Su Ding'anHe came forward with a smile on his face, a bit of a businessman in his respect.
"Oh? Are you here to receive an errand too?" Lu Yuan also had a look of surprise in his eyes.
"That's not..." Su Ding'an looked mysterious and lowered his voice: "Mr. Lu, to tell you the truth, despite the strict rules of the Siwu Hall, we are not without people."
As he spoke, he pursed his lips in the direction of the counter.
"Well, Old Liu, the scribe, is the niece of his wife's third concubine. He comes from the same village as my hometown. For that matter, I have to call him my cousin's brother-in-law."
The corner of Lu Yuan's mouth twitched slightly. This relationship was so convoluted that an illiterate person would have gotten lost on the spot.
Su Ding'an didn't think anything of it and asked casually: "Master Lu, are you here to receive an errand?"
Lu Yuan nodded, "Not bad."
"That's just right! I know the secrets of this errand room!"
"Which job is more profitable, which job is less risky, which job is easier to make meritorious deeds, as long as Mr. Lu asks, I will definitely find it for you."
"It's just... looking for a job for five cents."
Su Ding'an chuckled, his eyes shining.
Lu Yuan thought for a moment, took out five pieces of silver from his arms, and handed it over.
"Mr. Lu is awesome!"
Su Ding'an made a thumbs up gesture, took the silver and stuffed it into his sleeve with smooth movements.
Looking up again, his expression was a little more serious.
"I wonder what kind of errand Mr. Lu wants to take on?"
"Those who can kill demons." Lu Yuan blurted out, and then added: "If there are many demons, it is best if they are all of the same kind."
"The same kind?" Su Ding'an blinked, "Why?"
"Practice."
Lu Yuan responded casually, after all, it was not easy to spread the word about the entry.
Su Ding'an listened and nodded thoughtfully, his eyes suddenly lit up.
"It makes sense! It makes sense!"
"Killing the same kind of monster, the more you kill, the deeper your understanding becomes. Once you get the hang of it, it's all about chopping melons and vegetables!"
"Ouch, why didn't I think of this level before?"
"..."
Su Ding'an muttered while turning and walking towards the cabinet on the wall.
Soon, he came over with a file.
"Sir Lu, a monster problem was reported in Chixia County a few days ago, which exactly meets your requirements."
"What monster?" Lu Yuan's eyes flashed with excitement.
"Blood demon!"
The smile on Su Ding'an's face faded, and he rarely showed some seriousness.
"The blood demon is very evil. People killed by it will be transformed into new blood demons. The new blood demons can turn into blood demons again when they kill others."
"So, as long as one blood demon kills someone, a whole nest of them will appear within a few days."
"Since they are all born to the same mother, they must all be the same kind of monster."
Lu Yuan nodded, opened the file, and took a look at the information about the monsters in Chixia County:
In recent days, dozens of first-level warriors have disappeared one after another in Chixia County, with no bodies found alive or dead.
Someone witnessed the Chen family's mansion erupting in blood in the middle of the night. Although it only lasted for a short moment, the aura was astonishing, and it was suspected that a blood demon was lurking.
Lu Ming nodded and put away the file.
"Okay, that's it."
